# Official documentation snapshot

This directory contains one unmodified official workbook used by the README
and Getting Started article. It is installed with `readjsa` so the documented
discover, select, fetch/cache, parse, filter and chart workflow can run
deterministically without a network request or fabricated product data.

- Installed file: `ivi_skill_states_2026-06.xlsx`
- Publisher filename:

The installed file is byte-for-byte identical to the verified official
download. Its XLSX archive contains no embedded media. The package chart uses
tabular observations only and reproduces the publisher attribution and
licence statement. The publisher's terms exclude third-party content, the
Commonwealth Coat of Arms, trade-mark-protected material, images and
photographs from the general CC BY 4.0 grant; those terms remain authoritative.
